findings.title: Passing metadata preflight omits mandatory scanner/ClamAV startup bindings
findings.actual: The complete passing test fixture omits worker MALWARE_SCANNER_TOKEN and all four mandatory CLAMAV_HOST/CLAMAV_ALLOWED_HOSTS/CLAMAV_NETWORK_MODE/CLAMAV_ENGINE_VERSION bindings. Worker startup requires them.
findings.expected: Missing mandatory worker bindings fail metadata validation without reading or reporting secret values.
findings.recommendation: Require their presence and verify non-secret ClamAV configuration semantics; add missing-binding cases.
findings.resolution: Worker metadata now requires the scanner token and all mandatory ClamAV bindings; non-secret engine/network/allowlist/DNS/bounds and Node22 metadata are validated with explicit unobserved states.

findings.title: Readiness retains the previous successful poll while the current poll is pending
findings.actual: Pure local reproduction: successful first cycle => ready; begin a second unresolved Outbox poll => readiness still ready. Bounded fetch limits individual calls but a50-event sequential batch can remain active for many minutes.
findings.expected: A running, stale or failed cycle must not certify current readiness.
findings.recommendation: Invalidate or timestamp state on cycle start and test healthy→pending→failure transitions. Preserve scanner fail-closed behavior.
findings.resolution: Successful dependency evidence expires after60seconds on a monotonic clock. Pending cycles may retain a recent success within that explicit freshness window, but stale/pending evidence becomes not_ready after its lease. A non-overlapping worker loop prevents duplicate completion callbacks and publishes independent periodic heartbeat updates.

observations: No direct secret logging found in reviewed startup/preflight paths; preflight errors are fixed codes and findings use variable names.
Docker runtime uses non-root node, excludes private environment/key files and mounts proxy CA as a build secret. Real Docker execution reported by parent, not repeated by this reviewer.
Bounded fetch preserves caller cancellation and attaches a deadline to response-body consumption.
Preview app/backend origins and Auth metadata are compared against the production baseline; unknown baseline is not silently accepted.
Concurrent polling ticks share one completion Promise instead of attaching repeated heartbeat callbacks.
Periodic heartbeat updates are independently non-overlapping and re-read stale scanner state before scanner/ClamAV heartbeat RPCs.
The resulting health model intentionally permits a recent successful result for less than60seconds, rather than reporting every ordinary poll as immediately unavailable.
